comparison.objective: Candidate changes and locks a damper setting based on repeated carriage response; pr-1896 measures tyre pressure with a pencil gauge and replaces the gauge.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, tightening, and repeated control actuation. pr-1896 requires coaxial gauge-to-valve seating, sustained axial pressing sufficient to open the core, reading, and upright replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe physical stopping cycles and retained adjustment. pr-1896 requires a 1.5 s sealed press, a 33–37 psi stick indication, and gauge replacement within pose, clearance, and stillness limits.
comparison.reason: The record measures an existing pressure through a sealed valve interface; the candidate physically tunes and locks energy absorption, then validates dynamic behavior. Shared axial alignment and observation are generic. Candidate response and drift limits are not fully numeric.
